The Status of One Refitted Cluster Replicate With Regrouped Effects

Source: R/bootstrap_cluster_random.R
boot_cluster_validate.Rd

Returns 0 for a replicate that is kept, 2 when its mode error exceeds mode_error_limit() or cannot be read, and 3 when it leaves unidentified a coordinate that the fit identifies.

Usage

boot_cluster_validate(object, spec_b, r, cfg, ref, cb)

Arguments

object

The StatmodFit().

spec_b

The specification of the replicate.

r

The refit, as bootstrap_refit() returns it.

cfg

The inner settings of the fit.

ref

The reading of the fit itself, from boot_read_mode().

cb

The result of the build function of boot_cluster_random_plan().

Value

A single integer.

Details

It is boot_validate() with the stacked positions translated: the pinned coordinates and the unidentified ones of the fit are mapped to the positions of the replicate, and only the coordinates that the replicate shares with the fit are compared. The effects of the regrouped terms have no counterpart in the fit and are not compared.
